d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, aaj super quick 5 minute me banne wali Mango Juice ki Recipe Share kar raha hu, ye 1 aam se 5 glass ban jate hai aur flavor iska ekdam majboot hota hai kyuki mango dilute bilkul nahi hota hai, aap bhi jarur try karigea, ye aam ka juice pi ke maja aa jaega, aise lagega ki aap liquid aam pi rahe ho!
Recipe Mango Juice:
Mango - 1 medium size, I used Kesar Gujarat Aam
Mishri - 1/2 katori / 75g
Pani - 1/2 cup to soak mishri 1 minute
Ice Cubes - 6-7 pieces
Water - 3 1/2 cups to 4 cups
Ice cubes to serve
